notes.content:
- Add achievements related to the new difficulty levels of the PVE mode.
- Improve the display of the difficulties of the PVE mode.
- Bug fixes.
You now have access to many difficulties for the PVE mode with many bonuses. 10 levels of difficulty are available for the moment.

- Add a new spell for Linda.
- Balancing spells and items.
- Event : Loot chance increased by 100% for items.
- Event : Gold gain increased by 100%.
- bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
Improvement of the display of the cooldowns.
Improved display of the loots.

notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
Discover the most important update of the game.

- New combat mode "RPG".
- Modification of the spells of the characters.

You can change your mode by clicking on the button in the bottom left on the home page.

notes.title: Update 1.10.1
notes.content:
- When you delete an item (except quality common) you will receive enhancement materials.
- The chances of success have been improved.
- You only need to click on a card once to play it.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.
notes.content:
- Added PVE mode.
- Added PVE potion.
- Added ability to increase item level.
- Graphic change of the cards.
- Resolution of many bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
- You can now enable automatic targeting by card type (offensive or defensive).
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
- Added an option button in the battle scene.
- Added battle damage bonus.

notes.title: 1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
- Added legendaries to vendor and loot.
- Improved vendor display.
- You have a gold bonus for rewards related to your trophy numbers.
- Improved bots.
- Problem solving when returning damage.

Legendary items will probably receive balances as they go. More legendary items will arrive next week.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
- You can use the number keys on your keyboard to play cards.
- Add the option for auto target.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Displaying aura descriptions if you hover your mouse over them.
- The backgrounds of looted items are now the color of the quality.
- Adding animations when displaying loots and auras.
- Return of a countdown timer before reappearing if all the player's characters are dead.
- Performance improvements.

notes.title: Updates 1.0.5
notes.content: - Adding an automatic targeting system. This is a test. We'll see if it's positive or negative.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
- New resurrection display.
- Ability to sort items in your bag by quality.
- Fixes for some text issues with certain resolutions.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Added display of auras above the character's health bar.
- Display of two swords above the character to indicate that they are the player's characters.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added a function to delete all items of quality common, uncommon, and rare from the selected bag.
- You now earn 6 trophies per victory in 2vs2.
- Optimized bots.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Added a new system to target characters more easily.
- Changed the color of the health bars.
- Fixed some minor issues.
